---
title: "Ethnic bias in stop and search"
output: html_document
date: "2025-09-11"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, cache = TRUE)

source("fit_single_model.R")
source("initial_analysis.R")
source("excursions_by_year.R")
source("load_area_data.R")
source("prior_sensitivity.R")
source("k_sensitivity.R")
```

Load the data:
```{r load-data, echo=FALSE}
data <- load.stop.search.data()
areas <- load.areas.data()
```

Fit the model:
```{r fit-model}
set.seed(34982)
model <- fit.single.model(data)
```

Temporal Plot:
```{r plot-temporal}
plot.temporal(model)
```

Compute overall excursion sets:
```{r overall-exset}
overall.ex.sets <- compute.overall.excursion.sets(model, data)

overall.ex.sets
```

Plot overall excursion sets:
```{r plot-exset}
plot.overall.excursion.sets(overall.ex.sets)
```

Compute ratios by force and year:
```{r compute-ratios-by-force-and-year}
ratios.by.force.and.year <- compute.ratios.over.force.and.year(model)
```

Compute Asian excursion sets
```{r compute-asian-excursion-set-by-year}
asian.excursion.set.by.year <- compute.asian.excursion.sets.by.year(ratios.by.force.and.year)
```

Plot Asian excursion sets by year:
```{r}
plot.excursion.set.by.year(asian.excursion.set.by.year, areas)
```

Compute Black excursion sets
```{r compute-black-excursion-set-by-year}
black.excursion.set.by.year <- compute.black.excursion.sets.by.year(ratios.by.force.and.year)
```

Plot Black excursion sets by year:
```{r}
plot.excursion.set.by.year(black.excursion.set.by.year, areas)
```

Fit k-models
```{r k-fits}
ks <- c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1)

k.models <- fit.models.with.varying.k(ks, data)
```


Plot k-models
```{r plot-k-fits}
temporal.plot.varying.k(k.models)
```

Compute k-excursions
```{r k-excursions}
k.excursions <- compute.excursion.sets.with.varying.k(k.models, data)
```

```{r}
k.excursions
```
